newsitem.title: USA: Protein Design gets U.S. patent.
newsitem.headline: Protein Design gets U.S. patent.

text.p: Protein Design Labs Inc Tuesday said it has been issued a fundamental patent by the United States Patent and Trademark Office that covers most humanized monoclonal antibodies.

In a statement, the company said on December 11 it granted a license to one of the five largest Japanese pharmaceutical companies for a humanized antibody developed by that company. Under the agreement Protein Design will receive a $1,000,000 non-refundable upfront licensing payment and royalties on potential product sales.
The company said the patent covers the manufacture, use, sale or importation of humanized antibodies in the U.S. and has a term ending in 2013.

In January 1996, Protein Design was granted a similar patent by the European Patent Office. This European patent also covers most humanized antibodies and applies in Great Britain, Germany, France, Italy and eight other European countries.
